form: ln F *= t(age) sum_k w_k(Teff) (a_k + b_k x) per component; x = clip(log10 age/yr, log_age_range) - log_age_pivot; w_k linear in Teff on teff_knots, held below the first, zero from the last; t = 1 below taper_log_age[0], smoothstep to 0 at taper_log_age[1]
error_term: one column amplitude_scatter(Teff) x correction x flux at the primary's Teff and the system age, and diagonal extra_diag(Teff) x taper x flux
channels: XP61 + J/H/Ks (64); W1/W2 and SPHEREx are not supported
units: ln F_lambda; amplitude_scatter in units of the correction; extra_diag fractional

calibration.sample: 911 Hunt & Reffert (2024) members of 68 open clusters within 500 pc, logAge50 7.0-8.3, Prob >= 0.9, RUWE < 1.4, G < 17.5, photometric binaries and parallax outliers removed
calibration.reference: 1068 high-latitude field dwarfs matched in G and BP-RP, ms-region fits with free [M/H]
calibration.fit: XP61 + 2MASS JHKs in the fit_whitedwarf_companion frame, [M/H] = 0, age prior logAge50 +- 0.3 dex, fitted parallax, Gaussian E prior from the cluster A_V50
calibration.regression: (1 + r_member) = (1 + r_field(Teff)) exp(c(Teff, x)), x from the cluster logAge50; Huber-weighted penalised Gauss-Newton
calibration.iterations: labels refitted twice with out-of-fold corrections

validation.statistic: chi2 of the median member - field residual per Teff bin under the dwarf model covariance plus sampling errors, 63 channels, out-of-fold corrections
